[[File:Maarten Logghe 1996 Worlds.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Maarten Logghe at the 1996 World Championship.]]
'''Maarten Logghe''' was one of the twelve finalists at the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]] in Vail.

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm a 22 year old Computer Science student. I started playing Star Wars CCG right from the beginning. I hadn't even seen the movies yet. I was about to quit the game because none of my friends wanted to play, but finally, my friend Bastiaan Proot bought the game, together with Stefaan Destoop. I stayed in the game and lucky I was! Last year, playing in the Regional qualifier, my first tournament, I managed to win and so went to the first Star Wars CCG championship! It was so great my friends went to London to try their luck. And Stefaan won there! Woohoo, two Belgians at the worlds in Vail. We all had a great time and I'm looking forward to this year's event. I'm very proud to qualify a second time, but I'm more afraid now than last year. Fortunately there will be 2 Belgians again this year, as Bastiaan Proot qualified. My other interests are soccer, and trying to get my degree in Computer Science."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/logghe.html Maarten Logghe], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427234137/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/logghe.html Internet Archive]</ref>
